persona: Domestic dispatch executive at an FMCG depot moving to a broader logistics coordinator role
resumeText:
Imran Shaikh | Thane | imran.shaikh@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Dispatch Executive, Konkan Consumer Goods, Bhiwandi depot (2022 - present)
- Planned daily dispatch of 15 to 20 trucks to distributors across Maharashtra.
- Coordinated with six transporters and one 3PL partner for vehicle placement.
- Generated e-way bills and delivery challans for every outbound load.
- Verified freight bills against agreed transporter rates before sending them to accounts.
- Coordinated with the warehouse team on loading schedules and stock transfers to other depots.
- Maintained the dispatch tracker and proof of delivery status in Excel.

Logistics Trainee, Sahyog Roadways, Thane (2021 - 2022)
- Booked part-truck loads and updated customers on shipment status.

SKILLS
E-way bill portal, Excel, SAP end user

EDUCATION
BCom, University of Mumbai, 2021
